description: This file contains a jQuery plugin implementation for simple pagination, including functions for generating navigation controls, formatting numbers, and handling pagination logic with customizable options.

methods.name: simple_pagination_navigation
methods.description: Generates pagination navigation HTML dynamically based on settings.

methods.name: simple_number_formatter
methods.description: Formats numbers with specified decimal places, thousands separator, and decimal separator.

methods.name: refresh_page
methods.description: Shows/hides items for a specific page.

methods.name: refresh_first
methods.description: Creates HTML for the 'First' page navigation button.

methods.name: refresh_previous
methods.description: Creates HTML for the 'Previous' page navigation button.

methods.name: refresh_next
methods.description: Creates HTML for the 'Next' page navigation button.

methods.name: refresh_last
methods.description: Creates HTML for the 'Last' page navigation button.

methods.name: refresh_page_numbers
methods.description: Generates HTML for page number links, centered around current page.

methods.name: refresh_items_per_page_list
methods.description: Creates options list for items per page selection.

methods.name: refresh_specific_page_list
methods.description: Creates options list for specific page selection.

methods.name: refresh_simple_pagination
methods.description: Updates pagination controls and visible items for a given page.
